document.abstract: Eastman color high-speed negative film 5293/7293 has an exposure index of 250 and wide exposure latitude. This new film is designed to complement Eastman color negative film 5247, thus extending the creative freedom of the cinematographer in special applications where additional lighting is difficult, uneconomical, or undesirable. The sensitometric characteristics, image structure, color rendition, and performance of the new film are discussed.
